thesis: GMAB is a profitable, strongly trending biotech (close 51.37 above SMA20 49.9953, SMA50 41.1533 and SMA200 31.5401, rs_63 +0.63) pulling back toward the 20-day SMA and the 50.68 swing low after the Oct 28 gap, in a sector that leads the risk-off tape. Against the 49.6 stop, the 59.5 target (just under the 59.97 52-week high) gives about 4.6 R/R from the 51.37 close, 3.1 from the 52.0 zone top and 2.4 even at the 52.52 pre-market quote. However, the cause of the spike is unknown, insiders are selling, the post-spike fade still shows lower highs and lower lows, and the stop is only about 0.8 ATR away, so this is a low-confidence pullback-only position, not a chase.
invalidation: A daily close below 49.6 (under the 50.68 10-day swing low), or a close back below the 20-day SMA (about 50.0) on rising volume, voids the setup and opens a retrace toward the 44.67-45.44 gap zone.
key_risks: The driver of the Oct 28 gap (44.67 to 57.29 on 29.3M shares) is not in the packet; if it was a one-off, the 44.7-45.4 gap is the natural retrace level
Insider selling by the CEO (22,000 shares), the commercial chief and another officer after the spike, plus minor warrant dilution (about 0.26%)
Tight stop (about 0.8 ATR, atr 2.32) in a risk-off regime with VIX percentile 0.82 and ^TNX percentile 0.914, so whipsaw risk is high
Rich valuation (trailing P/E 43.9, forward 32.5) with earningsGrowth -0.147 and an empty SEC quarterly series, so growth cannot be verified
The 52.52 pre-market quote is above the entry zone; a fill counts only on a dip into 50.9-52.0
Correlation: adds to an already healthcare-heavy book (lessons item 6)
